title: Voice VLAN missing after a switch configuration change
scenario: A switchport is intended to provide data VLAN 10 and voice VLAN 30. The attached PC can still reach its same-VLAN peer. Phone power has been verified. You have the following switch evidence; no assumption about the phone’s fallback addressing is required.

exhibits.title: SW1 switchport excerpt
exhibits.text:
Name: Fa0/7
Operational Mode: static access
Access Mode VLAN: 10 (USERS)
Voice VLAN: 30 (Inactive)

exhibits.title: Completed VLAN-presence check
exhibits.text: The complete VLAN database contains active user VLANs 10 and 20. VLAN 30 is absent; this is not merely an omitted line from an excerpt.

question: Which switch-side correction follows directly from this evidence?
options: Change the port's voice VLAN to the working data VLAN
Clear the MAC table without changing the VLAN database
Change the phone's address before restoring its intended VLAN
Restore the intended VLAN 30 in the VLAN database
explanation: The port references voice VLAN 30, but the VLAN is inactive and missing from the relevant database entries. Restore it, then verify port state and the phone’s separate provisioning and IP services. Data connectivity in VLAN 10 does not establish that voice works.
fix:
```ios SW1
SW1# configure terminal
SW1(config)# vlan 30
SW1(config-vlan)# name VOICE
SW1(config-vlan)# end
SW1# show vlan brief
SW1# show interfaces fastethernet0/7 switchport
```
Confirm that voice VLAN 30 is active. Then check the phone’s actual VLAN settings and required IP/call services; the VLAN correction alone does not prove registration.

title: A workstation joins the wrong VLAN after a desk move
scenario: A workstation at 192.168.10.55/24 moves to a jack patched to SW1 Fa0/18. Its intended peers, including 192.168.10.60/24, remain in VLAN 10. The workstation cannot reach those peers. Its address and cable have been verified; no VLAN translation or alternate link connects the VLANs.

exhibits.title: SW1# show interfaces fa0/18 switchport — excerpt
exhibits.text:
Administrative Mode: static access
Operational Mode: static access
Access Mode VLAN: 20 (PRINTERS)

exhibits.title: Fresh source traffic learned on Fa0/18
exhibits.text:
Vlan  Mac Address     Type     Ports
20    0050.0f77.4a19   DYNAMIC  Fa0/18

question: What is the cause of the failed same-subnet communication?
options: The port is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of the required VLAN 10
The workstation's gateway must carry its same-subnet ARP requests
VLAN 20 is absent despite its reported active membership
The learned MAC entry is stale and still describes the old jack
explanation: The host addresses place the peers in the same IPv4 subnet, but the actual Layer 2 assignments separate them. The MAC-table entry confirms where fresh source traffic is learned. Restore the documented VLAN assignment and verify the local path. The entry was learned from fresh traffic on the new port, so clearing a supposedly stale record would not change its actual VLAN assignment.
fix:
```ios SW1
SW1# configure terminal
SW1(config)# interface fastethernet0/18
SW1(config-if)# description User workstation
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode access
SW1(config-if)# switchport access vlan 10
SW1(config-if)# end
SW1# show interfaces fastethernet0/18 switchport
```
Generate fresh traffic, verify the MAC entry in VLAN 10, and retest the peer. Save the corrected configuration after verification.
